title: Neutral-hydrogen line and Wow! signal frequency estimates
description: A machine-readable reference binding the H I 21 cm rest frequency to one historical and one modern Wow! signal frequency estimate without treating either estimate as a decoded message.
rights_statement: The local JSON is a normalized factual transcription prepared for reproducible analysis. Rights in external publications and webpages remain with their respective authors and publishers.

artifacts.description: Neutral-hydrogen rest frequency and two explicitly sourced Wow! signal frequency estimates.
